messages:
Maya Patel: opened PR to update Horizon6b model entry in the catalog — adding supported runtimes, sequence limits, quant profiles, and a small SDK v3 streaming example. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/1487

Sam Chen: quick q — sequence_limit currently set to 8192 in the draft. we hit mem blowups in internal long-context tests around 9k tokens on A100-40GB. is 8k the firm ceiling?

Frank Li: confirmed. our bench runs (quant q4_0) start to show unstable memory >8k for batch=1 on 40GB. summary below from local perf run: 
```
model: Horizon6b (q4_0)
input_len: 8192 -> OK (p50 120ms, p95 230ms)
input_len: 9216 -> OOM in 2/10 runs, peak GPU mem ~41.3GB
throughput tokens/s: 45 (seq=8192), 38 (seq=4096)
env: cuda 12.2, pytorch 2.2, cuBLAS tuned
```
Use seq_limit=8192 unless ops wants to add an explicit warning about instability >8k.

Elena Gomez: thanks Frank. Docs note idea: add "recommended sequence_limit: 8192" + note "longer contexts may work but can trigger OOM on 40GB GPUs; prefer Dedicated or shard-backed runtimes for >8k". also will you paste the exact quant-profile string you tested so we can include it in the model card?

Frank Li: quant profile used: `q4_0-packed-int8` (internal name: q4_0_pack_v2). I'll add the exact CLI we used: `./bench --model Horizon6b --quant q4_0_pack_v2 --seq 8192 --batch 1`

QA Ops: also flag for compat matrix — on older drivers (cuda 11.x + older cuBLAS) we saw degraded perf and occasional kernel fallbacks. add a compatibility row: "cuda >= 12.1 recommended; older drivers may fall back to slower kernels". QA can attach the test matrix if helpful.

Maya Patel: good call. I'll update the YAML fields in the PR to include `sequence_limit: "8192"`, `supports_streaming: "true"`, `recommended_cuda: ">=12.1"`, and add a short compatibility note.

Elena Gomez: we also need a small SDK v3 streaming snippet that matches the Console examples — suggested minimal snippet below (please sanity-check):
```python
# SDK v3 streaming example (python)
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="${REDWOOD_KEY}")
with client.generate_stream(model="horizon6b") as stream:
    for chunk in stream:
        print(chunk.text, end="")
```
Replace `generate_stream` with the actual method name if runtime changed. We should include a one-line comment about backoff and restart on partial KV cache misses.

Sam Chen: small nit — the PR currently links to `/docs/benchmarks/horizon6b.md` but that subpage doesn't exist yet (dead link). Elena, can you point the model card to the canonical benchmarking page `/docs/benchmarks/long-context` instead, and add a TODO to create a dedicated Horizon6b bench page later?

Elena Gomez: yep will change the link and add a note to open a tracking ticket for the dedicated bench page. Also will add the inline code example above into `docs/snippets/sdk_v3_streaming.md` and reference it from the model card.

Frank Li: pushed a small follow-up commit with the exact quant profile and the bench CSV export. commit 6f8a2e3.

Docs Bot: preview for PR 1487 is up: https://deploy-preview.redwood-docs/pr-1487 — includes the updated model card draft and snippet page. automated linkcheck passed except for one external link to the original model repo (timeout).

QA Ops: leaving a note — please add a compatibility sentence for CPU fallback: horizon6b falls back to CPU-only in very low-memory edge cases but throughput will be very slow; recommend Dedicated or Dedicated-Sharded for production long-context.

Maya Patel: thanks everyone — I updated the PR with the wording from QA and changed the dead link to `/docs/benchmarks/long-context`. Elena will submit final docs review, then i'll merge after CI + docs-bot preview check. @Frank Li @Sam Chen please approve if nothing else. :thumbsup:

Sam Chen: approved. :+1:

Frank Li: approved. merging when green. :rocket:
